lcc_original: 亞當又和妻子同房，妻子就生了一個兒子，並給他起名叫塞特，意思是說：『上帝給我立了另一個後裔來代替亞伯，因爲該隱殺了他。』
notes: LCC uses 和 where UNV uses 與 (both = preposition 'with'); <WAH0853> attached to 和
LCC repeats 妻子 as explicit subject of 生了 (UNV uses pronoun 她); no SN for this second 妻子 — the subject is embedded in the Hebrew verb form, not a separate lexical item
LCC 起名 is a Chinese compound corresponding to UNV's separate 起<WH07121><WTH8799> + 名<WH08034>; both SNs merged onto the compound, morphology tag kept immediately after its verb SN
LCC uses 後裔 (descendants/seed) where UNV uses 兒子 for <WH02233> (זֶרַע zera = seed); LCC is more literal to the Hebrew; SN attached to 後裔
另 precedes 給我 in UNV but follows 立了 in LCC; SNs follow LCC word order throughout
來 before 代替 in LCC is a Chinese aspect/purpose particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated
